integrity: Two separately implemented exhaustive Python programs and a complete canonical state-transition certificate. No assertion for larger generalized Petersen graphs.
scientific_limitations: Complete exact computation concerns only the twenty-vertex Desargues graph GP(10,3) and the explicitly specified Roman-label changes P1, P2 and P3. The known minimum Roman weight is not original. Literature search may miss unindexed equivalent results. Independent external scientific audit not performed.
title: Frozen and mobile minimum Roman functions of the Desargues graph
